description: This source file implements command-line testing tools for lazy initialization and hash table performance analysis within a version control repository context. It includes functions for dumping hash tables, timing runs, and analyzing multi-threaded performance, with command-line options for different modes.

methods.name: dump_run
methods.description: Dumps the contents of directory and name hash tables to stdout for verification.

methods.name: time_runs
methods.description: Runs the lazy init hash process multiple times, measuring and printing execution time.

methods.name: analyze_run
methods.description: Performs performance analysis by varying cache sizes and measuring timing for single and multi-threaded runs.

methods.name: cmd__lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Main command function parsing options and executing dump, performance, or analysis modes.
